document_ocr_revisions:
CREATE TABLE `document_ocr_revisions` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `original_version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `kind` enum('ocr','review') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `body` mediumtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `pages` json NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`class_id`,`revision`),
  KEY `fk_ocr_revision_original` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`original_version`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_revision_original` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `original_version`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`, `class_id`, `version`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_body` CHECK ((length(`body`) between 1 and 2097152)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_pages` CHECK (((json_type(`pages`) = _utf8mb4'ARRAY') and (json_length(`pages`) between 1 and 100))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_revision` CHECK (((`original_version` = 1) and (`revision` between 1 and 2147483647)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
document_ocr_heads:
CREATE TABLE `document_ocr_heads` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `latest_revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `published_revision` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`class_id`),
  KEY `fk_ocr_head_latest` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`latest_revision`),
  KEY `fk_ocr_head_published` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`published_revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_head_latest` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `latest_revision`) REFERENCES `document_ocr_revisions` (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_head_published` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `published_revision`) REFERENCES `document_ocr_revisions` (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_head_order` CHECK (((`published_revision` is null) or (`published_revision` <= `latest_revision`)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
document_ocr_review_keys:
CREATE TABLE `document_ocr_review_keys` (
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `idem_key` varbinary(64) NOT NULL,
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `payload_digest` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  `response_bytes` varbinary(512) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`class_id`,`document_id`,`idem_key`),
  KEY `fk_ocr_review_revision` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_review_revision` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`) REFERENCES `document_ocr_revisions` (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_review_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_review_key` CHECK ((length(`idem_key`) between 16 and 64))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
document_ocr_chunks:
CREATE TABLE `document_ocr_chunks` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `revision` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `ordinal` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `page` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `char_start` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `char_end` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `quote` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`class_id`,`revision`,`ordinal`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_chunk_revision` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`) REFERENCES `document_ocr_revisions` (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_chunk` CHECK (((`ordinal` > 0) and (`page` between 1 and 100) and (`char_end` > `char_start`) and (`char_end` <= 2097152) and (char_length(`quote`) = (`char_end` - `char_start`))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
document_ocr_sources:
CREATE TABLE `document_ocr_sources` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `revision` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `source_bytes` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `source_digest` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  `original_digest` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`class_id`),
  KEY `fk_ocr_source_revision` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_source_revision` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`) REFERENCES `document_ocr_revisions` (`document_id`, `class_id`, `revision`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_source` CHECK (((`revision` = 1) and (length(`source_bytes`) between 1 and 8388608)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
document_ocr_jobs:
CREATE TABLE `document_ocr_jobs` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `class_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `original_version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `state` enum('queued','processing','succeeded','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `original_digest` binary(32) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `execution_epoch` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `worker_owner` binary(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_until` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `failure_reason` enum('corrupt','encrypted','unsupported_content','resource_limit','ocr_timeout','worker_interrupted','language_missing','internal_failure') COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`class_id`),
  KEY `ix_ocr_job_claim` (`state`,`lease_until`,`document_id`),
  KEY `fk_ocr_job_original` (`document_id`,`class_id`,`original_version`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ocr_job_original` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`, `class_id`, `original_version`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`, `class_id`, `version`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_ocr_job` CHECK (((`original_version` = 1) and (`attempts` <= 3) and (((`state` = _utf8mb4'queued') and (`attempts` <= 2) and (`execution_epoch` = `attempts`) and (`worker_owner` is null) and (`lease_until` is null) and (`failure_reason` is null)) or ((`state` = _utf8mb4'processing') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`execution_epoch` = `attempts`) and (`worker_owner` is not null) and (`lease_until` is not null) and (`failure_reason` is null)) or ((`state` = _utf8mb4'succeeded') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`execution_epoch` = `attempts`) and (`worker_owner` is null) and (`lease_until` is null) and (`failure_reason` is null)) or ((`state` = _utf8mb4'failed') and (`attempts` between 1 and 3) and (`execution_epoch` = `attempts`) and (`worker_owner` is null) and (`lease_until` is null) and (`failure_reason` is not null)))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC
